import bpy, os, json
from mathutils import Vector
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\\mcp-blender\\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected:
    raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
name='WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout'
o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
if not o: raise RuntimeError('TERRENO MASTER ausente')
pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
print('OBJECT',o.name,'TYPE',o.type)
print('COLLECTIONS',[c.name for c in o.users_collection])
print('LOCATION',tuple(round(v,6) for v in o.location),'ROT',tuple(round(v,6) for v in o.rotation_euler),'SCALE',tuple(round(v,6) for v in o.scale))
print('DIMS',tuple(round(v,6) for v in o.dimensions))
print('BOUNDS',tuple(round(min(p[i] for p in pts),6) for i in range(3)),tuple(round(max(p[i] for p in pts),6) for i in range(3)))
if o.type=='MESH':
    me=o.data
    print('MESH',me.name,'VERTS',len(me.vertices),'EDGES',len(me.edges),'POLYS',len(me.polygons),'UVS',len(me.uv_layers))
    zs=[(o.matrix_world@v.co).z for v in me.vertices]
    print('VERT_Z_RANGE',round(min(zs),6),round(max(zs),6),'UNIQUE_Z_ROUNDED',sorted(set(round(z,3) for z in zs))[:80])
    print('MATERIALS',[m.name if m else None for m in me.materials])
print('PROPS',json.dumps({k:o[k] for k in o.keys() if k!='_RNA_UI'},ensure_ascii=False,default=str,separators=(',',':')))
mods=[]
for m in o.modifiers: mods.append({'name':m.name,'type':m.type,'show_viewport':m.show_viewport,'show_render':m.show_render})
print('MODIFIERS',json.dumps(mods,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('TERRAIN_MASTER_INSPECT_OK')
